content.title: Coachella 2026 Lineup & Schedule: See Every Performer Set Time for Weekend 1 Here
content.text: Composite: Getty ImagesThe countdown for Coachella 2026 is officially over, and if you are frantically looking for the Coachella 2026 lineup and schedule to plan your festival itinerary or watch party, then you've come to the right place.On September 15, 2025, the official Coachella account finally unveiled the long-anticipated lineup for the 2026 edition of the festival, and plenty of Teen Vogue faves have made the cut. After much speculation, we learned that the headliners of Coachella 2026 are none other than Sabrina Carpenter, Justin Bieber, and Karol G. They pick up the baton from last year's headliners, Lady Gaga, Green Day, and Post Malone. Italian DJ Anyma will also have a special stage during the 2026 festival, premiering the project ÆDEN.Coachella 2026 Lineup posterCourtesy of CoachellaAside from the headliners, there are plenty of other acts that should be on your radar for Coachella 2026, including Teen Vogue cover stars KATSEYE, anime soundtrackers Creepy Nuts, K-pop royalty Taemin and BIGBANG, as well as The Strokes, Addison Rae, Laufey, and countless more. Check out the full Coachella 2026 lineup and when exactly each act will perform broken down by days below.Friday dates (April 10 & 17)Sabrina Carpenter Mike Coppola/Getty ImagesSabrina Carpenter will serve as the headliner during both Fridays at Coachella. Following a major festival run last year, performing at anywhere from Primavera Sound to BST Hyde Park, she will make her return to Coachella as a headliner. The star made her Coachella debut on the main stage in the early hours of the afternoon in 2024, fresh off the release of her hit single “Espresso.”For weekend one, Sabrina Carpenter is expected to take the Coachella main stage at 9:05 p.m. PT.KATSEYE — 8:00 p.m. PT at the Sahara stageEthel Cain — 8:00 p.m. PT at the Sahara stageDijon — 6:40 p.m. PT at the Outdoor Theatre stageTeddy Swims — 5:30 p.m. PT at the Coachella main stageCentral Cee — 5:30 p.m. PT at the Mojave stageCMAT — 6:15 p.m. PT at the Gobi stageCreepy Nuts — 11:05 p.m. PT at the Gobi stageSwae Lee — 10:50 p.m. PT at the Sahara stageSexyy Red — 12:05 a.m. PT at the Sahara stageMore acts: The XX, Record Safari, Disclosure, Turnstile, Devo, Tiffany Tyson, Not For Radio, Holly Humberstone, Levity, Blood Orange, Moby, Marlon Hoffstadt, Lykke Li, fakemink, Gordo, Joyce Manor, BINI, Kettama, Groove Armada, Joost, HUGEL, Slayyyter, Prospa, Hot Mulligan, Fleshwater, Max Styler, Wednesday, Dabeull, The Two Lips, Ninajirachi, Novasoul, Max Dean x Luke Dean, Cachirula & Loojan, Jessica Brankka, Chloé Caillet x Rossi., Arodes, NewDad, Carolina Durante, Doom Dave, Febuary, Bob Baker Marionettes, Tiga, Deep Dish, PAWSA, Anyma, and Sahar Z.Saturday dates (April 11 & 18)Justin BieberCassy Athena/Getty ImagesJustin Bieber will serve as the headliner for the Saturday dates. Despite being an avid attendee, Coachella 2026 will mark Justin Bieber's first-ever headlining set at the famed festival—and first time at the festival, too. Though Bieber has appeared as a guest during other artists' sets, he has never graced a Coachella stage as part of the official lineup. Bieber released Swag and Swag II, both of which came out last year.For weekend one, Justin Bieber is expected to take the Coachella main stage at 11:25 p.m. PT.Addison Rae — 5:30 p.m. PT at the Coachella stageLabrinth — 8:30 p.m. PT at the Outdoor Theatre stageSOMBR — 7:05 p.m. PT at the Outdoor Theatre stageGIVEON — 7:00 p.m. PT at the Coachella stageRoyel Otis — 5:50 p.m. PT at the Mojave stageTaemin — 7:30 p.m. PT at the Mojave stagePinkPantheress — 8:55 p.m. PT at the Mojave stagerusowsky — 6:40 p.m. PT at the Sonora stageMore acts: David Guetta, Afrojack x Shimza, Joezi, The Strokes, Jacqck Glam, David Byrne, Interpol, AlexG, REZZ, Fujii Kaze, Adriatique, Nine Inch Noize, Davido, Boys Noize, Geese, ¥ØU$UK€ ¥UK1MAT$U, Hamdi, Luísa Sonza, ZULAN, TEED, Seek-One, Los Hermanos Flores, Bedouin, Ceremony, 54 Ultra, Noga Erez, Ben Sterling, Blondshell, Ecca Vandal, Mind Enterprises, Freak Slug, SOSA, Mahmut Orhan, Riordan, Die Spitz, Triste Juventud, Morat, BIA, WHATMORE, Jack White, Worship, Armin van Buuren x Adam Beyer, GENESI, and Yamagucci.Sunday dates (April 12 & 19)Karol G Buda Mendes/Getty ImagesKarol G will serve as the headliner for Sunday. Much like Carpenter, Coachella 2026 will mark Karol G's sophomore appearance at Indio, having made her Coachella debut in 2022. The Colombian star is expected to perform the first full live show rendition of her most recent album, Tropicoqueta, which was released in June 2025.For weekend one, Karol G is expected to take the Coachella main stage at 9:55 p.m. PT.BIGBANG — 10:30 p.m. PT at the Outdoor Theatre stageLaufey — 8:40 p.m. PT at the Outdoor Theatre stageYoung Thug — 7:50 p.m. PT at the Coachella main stageMajor Lazer — 6:10 p.m. PT at the Coachella main stageFKA twigs — 8:45 p.m. PT at the Mojave stageWet Leg — 4:45 p.m. PT at the Coachella main stageLittle Simz — 4:25 p.m. PT at the Mojave stageMore acts: Fatboy Slim, JOY (Anonymous), Jazzy, Tijuana Panthers, Gabe Real, Foster the People, Kaskade, Iggy Pop, Clipse, Subtronics, Mochakk, Duke Dumont, Girl Math, Gigi Perez, LOBOMAN, Juicewon, The Rapture, Suicidal Tendencies, Green Velvet × AYYBO, BUNT., WhoMadeWho, French Police, Black Flag, Oklou, Röyksopp, The Chats, flowerovlove, wyldeflower, DRAIN, Model/Actriz, COBRAH, Los Retros, Jane Remover, RØZ, Glitterer, Panda & Chok, Carlita x Josh Baker, MËSTIZA, &friends, AZZECCA, LE YORA, Samia, and Tomora.Check out the full schedules for Friday, Saturday, and Sunday of weekend one of Coachella 2026 below:This post will be refreshed as we learn more about specific timings for weekend two.Originally Appeared on Teen VogueWant more great Culture stories from Teen Vogue?
